# Fínán mac Duinn (C_FINAN), a survivor of the wreck on Sgeir Dhubh (Stage 13; Book 5 section 02, "Refugees from
# the sea"; Book 6 section 19), on the 32 x 48 canvas with their own layers: drawn by Claude and
# flagged for the user's review (decision DH-2). Generated by
# assets/art/authoring/stage13_wreck_people.py; edit that script, not this map.
# Cloak layer: lags a frame behind the body and settles after it; streams in a gust.
sheet: layer_cloak_brat_finan
kind: sprite
palette: book07
size: 32x48
pivot: 16,47
footprint: 10x4
facings: s n e w
placeholder: false
anim.idle: frames 4, ticks 4, loop
anim.shift: frames 4, ticks 20, loop
anim.glance: frames 4, ticks 24, loop
anim.idlewind: frames 4, ticks 6, loop
anim.walk: frames 6, ticks 5, loop
anim.run: frames 8, ticks 3, loop
anim.runstart: frames 2, ticks 4
anim.runstop: frames 2, ticks 6
anim.walkstart: frames 2, ticks 5
anim.walkstop: frames 2, ticks 4
anim.call: frames 6, ticks 9, loop
anim.down: frames 2, ticks 40, loop
anim.carried: frames 6, ticks 5, loop
event.footstep: walk 0, walk 3, run 0, run 4
pose.down: lying
pose.carried: carried
# The outline and the three tones are authored in the map (people48.py), aware of the
# layers below this one, so the generator adds no outline of its own.
outline: . 4
mark.A: earth 3
mark.B: earth 2
mark.C: earth 1
mark.D: earth 0
mark.k: ink 0
